sentences: I have always been fond of animals.
I have inherited this fondness since my parents also like animals very much.
I like to play with dogs and cats but there is one animal I am absolutely crazy about and that is horse.
When I was around 12 years old my father decided that I should pick up an activity outside my academic curriculum.
The two obvious choices were either some sport or some kind of musical instrument.
Since both my father and I are sport lovers so decision was a no brainer.
Now the dilemma was to choose the sports activity.
My father decided that I should join the horse riding club nearby our house.
My father chose this activity for a particular reason.
He loves horse riding and was a member of this club around 5 years ago.
He said that he would join the club again hence being able to accompany me and rekindle his love for horse riding.
I vividly remember the first time I rode a horse.
What began as a scare turned into a love affair only in a matter of minutes.
I had never seen an animal as gentle as a horse.
It is so quiet and easy to work with.
If we are gentle to it then it would easily understand and agree to what we want it to do.
I am absolutely fascinated by its speed which I witnessed for the first time in a horse race.
I had never seen an animal run this fast before.
At that moment I realized that why horses are associated with royalty.
I had heard of stories about how kings of old Indian provinces were obsessed about horses and took pride in their collection of horses.
I too dream of owning a horse one day.
